title: Unable to calibrate (Dexcom G6 1.6.5.25)
symptom: Running xDrip+ with Dexcom G6 with 80 tx Firmware 1.6.5.25 (rebatteried), calibrations are registered in Event Log but the message 'Calibration Accepted' never shows up. Calibrations are ignored, and instead an 'authentification notification throwable (CHECK_AUTH)' error appears, followed by signal loss and aggressive collector restart.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user reports the issue occurs after changing back to the 80 tx transmitter, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The user reports that the calibration issue is fixed by changed configuration and/or bugfix in recent nightlies, but no specific configuration change or fix is detailed.
evidence_quote: Calibration issue is fixed by changed configuration and/or bugfix in recent nightlies.
